title: User-Defined Functions Tutorial
description: Overview of user-defined functions including scalar and table-valued functions.

data.text: SQL Server user-defined functions help simplify development by encapsulating complex business logic and making it available for reuse in every query.

items: Scalar-valued functions — return a single value and can be used anywhere in T-SQL statements.
Table-valued functions — return a table of rows and can be used in the FROM clause of a query.
Inline table-valued functions — return the result of a single SELECT statement.
Multi-statement table-valued functions — use a table variable and can execute multiple queries.

data.title: User-Defined Functions Key Points
points: Scalar functions return a single value; table-valued functions return a table.
Functions encapsulate complex logic for reuse across queries.
Table-valued functions are more flexible than stored procedures.
Use DROP FUNCTION to remove existing functions.
